notes.note: Correction to the earlier note on this branch: the lock delta adds jsdom 30.1.3 and its own dependency tree (css-tree, bidi-js, mdn-data, @asamuzakjp/*, @bramus/specificity, @csstools/*; data-urls moves to whatwg-url 17.3.0) for the root and the vitest jsdom peers of the root, examples/fieldwork-review, packages/board-pane and packages/sdk. jsdom 31.0.0 stays in the lock for packages/basis-pane and packages/connect, which keep ^31.0.0. All of it is dev/test-only; no runtime, build or published package changes. This document makes no claim about jsdom, so it is unaffected.
